pr_title: Add support for SENSOR_ATTR_OFFSET, multiple instances, and update Kconfig for TMP117
pr_body:
Added support for SENSOR_ATTR_OFFSET and sample code for the [TI TMP117](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tmp117.pdf?ts=1607855698952). This PR also adds support for multiple instances, updates Kconfig to include TMP117.

This closes #30663
pr_comments:
@cfriedt I have combined the two drivers, i.e added support for tmp117 in the existing tmp116 driver, Also added some code in the sample to demonstrate tmp117.

@mniestroj I have resolved everything that you suggested.

issue_context.title: Support for TI's TMP117 Temperature Sensor.
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
I propose the addition of a driver for the tmp117 temperature sensor.
This sensor is very similar to the tmp116, which is already supported by the zephyr.
The difference between the two sensors is that tmp117 has more precision than tmp116.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
The driver can be added by making minimal changes to the existing tmp116 driver.
comments:
I want to work on this, please assign it to me.
Thanks

review_comments: list of params needs to be updated

This is wrong. According to `struct sensor_value` documentation you should use `val1 = 2` and `val2 = 500000` in that case. This means that code implementing `SENSOR_ATTR_OFFSET` for tmp117 is also invalid.
I changed the sample code and also fixed the driver to use val1 + val2^-6.
